reason: My first question is always whether it's really tested, and here the lab is named and the report for my batch is on the page, so I can check it myself. At $24.99 for the first box I'd try one and see if I sleep any better.
objection: I can get a big bottle of magnesium for way less per day, so at $29.99 I'm paying extra for the sachet and the lab report. If the launch price wasn't there I'd probably scroll past.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report didn't match the batch number on the box, or the price at checkout was the full $29.99 with no coupon.
